study_type: moderated task-based comprehension and usability test
preferred_population: MTO/PSP settlement, payments operations, treasury, reconciliation or payout operations practitioners
proxy_rule: Adjacent fintech product, banking operations, compliance or finance participants remain PROXY and may not be promoted to DIRECT_USER.
next_valid_transition: Recruit an eligible participant, obtain consent, capture an anonymized session against the frozen prototype, append atomic evidence, then synthesize without promoting technical QA or proxy evidence to DIRECT_USER.
iteration_gate: Do not make an evidence-driven product iteration until traceable human evidence supports a decision change. A changed UI remains ITERATION until affected tasks are retested.
retest_gate: Freeze the changed build and rerun the affected task(s) with compatible participants before making an improvement claim.
allowed_claims: FinFlow has an interactive multi-rail settlement concept prototype
Decision pins and forced edge-state fixtures are technically inspectable
Round 01 direct-user validation is ready to recruit
No verified direct-user sessions have been collected yet
forbidden_claims_until_verified: MTO or PSP operators validated the routing model
FinFlow reduces routing errors or reconciliation time
FinFlow improves conversion or demo-request rate
The iteration improved trust, task success or decision confidence
